name: @antfu/containers
description: Configs and setup for my personal container workflow, deployed with dev-container
author: Anthony Fu <anthonyfu117@hotmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run build:hub && pnpm dc generate && pnpm dc compose build
scripts.up: pnpm run build:hub && pnpm dc up
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test --run
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && simple-git-hooks && pnpm run vendor:setup && skills experimental_sync -y

scripts-info.bundle:hub: Run the hub stub bundler, uncached
scripts-info.build:hub: Bundle the hub stub into its image context, cached by turbo
scripts-info.knip: Find unused files, exports and dependencies
scripts-info.sync: Pull this repo and redeploy when it changed
scripts-info.autosync:install: Install the launchd agent that runs sync
scripts-info.vendor:setup: Init the submodules and build dev-container
scripts-info.vendor:upgrade: Move the submodules to their latest remote commit
scripts-info.ci: Run the full continuous integration pipeline
scripts-info.prepare: Set up git hooks and skills

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm run ci && pnpx nano-staged
